title: Practice: the Brood
summary: A small game against an Easy computer playing the Crown, with hints along the way. Destroy every enemy building to win.

say: A real game now, against an easy computer playing the Crown. I will give you hints.
Win by destroying every enemy building. First, more grubs from the Mother.
Good. Root a Mound Turtle for supply, and a Tyrant Sire beside the Mother.
Now lay Raptor eggs, again and again. The swarm wins by numbers.

say.pc: The Crown sits in the far corner, behind its wall. Gather the swarm, press A and click their base.
say.phone: The Crown sits in the far corner, behind its wall. Gather the swarm, tap ATTACK and tap their base.

say: Keep the Mother home and keep her laying.

late1.text: Your Rootmaws drink their ground dry in time. Root a turtle on new ground and a Rootmaw on its swamp.

lost: The computer won this time. Build up, defend your ramp, and try again.

you.text: You won a whole game. You are ready for a skirmish, or the campaign.
